title: Uruguayan Hind Shank Stew
description: A hearty and tender stew made with hind shank, featuring a shio-cure and whole30-friendly ingredients, perfect for a comforting meal prep dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the sea salt and black pepper to create the shio-cure.
Rub the shio-cure all over the hind shank pieces, making sure to coat them evenly.
Heat a large dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the hind shank pieces until browned on all sides.
Remove the browned hind shank from the pot and set it aside.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the browned hind shank to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours.
